title: JSFL frame.elements items are not writable proxies — mutations silently discarded
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the get elements() getter (lines ~218-221) returns a plain array of frozen DisplayObject model values. JSFL scripts that do frame.elements[0].x = 100 write to a discarded temporary copy — the document is never mutated. Fix: implement a writable Proxy layer for element access. Each element in the elements array should be wrapped in a Proxy that intercepts set operations and dispatches the corresponding stage_update (or equivalent doc mutation) when a property is assigned. This enables standard JSFL element-manipulation patterns.
